lessons.title: Authentication Mental Model
lessons.why: Here’s the simple reason this matters: Authentication establishes who the caller is. Everything that follows should use a verified identity instead of trusting user IDs sent in the request body. In this course, we connect it directly to identity, permissions, ownership, and tenant isolation across the TaskFlow system, so you can see where the idea lives in a real project instead of memorizing a definition.
objectives: Explain Authentication Mental Model in terms of inputs, owner, outputs, and failure modes.
Implement Authentication Mental Model incrementally and predict observable evidence before execution.
Diagnose a controlled Authentication Mental Model failure from evidence.
Apply Authentication Mental Model to a new TaskFlow requirement without copying the reference implementation.
